items.title: Ray Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, AZ, April 16, 2000
items.q: Because Quincy Jones did the unthinkable, he was the first guy to do this. He did a whole movie with no score.

ctx.x: Yeah. I’ve got my own guys.
Yeah. Because Quincy Jones did the unthinkable, he was the first guy to do this. He did a whole movie with no score. But he had all of his people in there. And it was successful.
Yeah, you better have the right personnel if you’re going to try to pull that off.
